description: Start or resume a lesson session and report whether it is new, resumed, or completed. When the learner already has this lesson open in this server, the same session_id is returned where it was, with resume.kind already_open and a display_markdown that opens with a line saying so. A completed lesson starts at scene zero as a retake and includes due profile-backed review targets. The authoring block (also on every presentation) says who wrote the lesson; when authoring.notice is set (a self-authored lesson), show it to the learner. Optionally select a BCP 47 presentation_language; when omitted, use the bundle's source language. With now_ms the session runs on a clock anchored there: its answers, ratings and reviews are dated from it. concept_map is the lesson's concept map as the session opens (see get_workflow_graph); the first presentation's display_markdown already shows it. When this client gives a faster surface than the chat (Studium's panel, a pane, the browser) and the learner did not last answer in the chat, that display_markdown ends with one line naming it; with open_panel {session_id} when it is the panel: call open_lesson_panel with it if the learner says “panel”.

now_ms.description: epoch ms, for deterministic scheduling: the session started with it stamps its answers, ratings and reviews there; defaults to the server clock

name: start_lesson_session
